title: 余潮再航
intended_use: 失败结算；一次性开头与余韵边界待实听标定

production.title: 失败结算 · 再整航装
production.version_note: 新30秒版不使用大提琴，延续旧曲开头克制情绪方向；文本生成不保证逐音符保留原旋律。

request.prompt: Instrumental thirty-second defeat results cue for an anime shipgirl naval game. A soft piano immediately plays a simple descending minor-key phrase, acknowledging disappointment calmly during the opening four seconds. Continue with a quiet tuneful reflective piano melody and sparse gentle low clarinet responses in the spaces between phrases. Only piano and clarinet. Preserve the feeling of the initial tender reflection throughout the short cue, with natural connected phrases and a small hopeful harmonic opening before returning gently. Care for companions and readiness to regroup, never despair or humiliation. Mostly quiet reflective aftermath, no repeated dramatic lament. The ending maintains the same calm accompaniment for possible aftermath loop selection. No cello, string section, percussion, triumphant fanfare, dense countermelodies or sudden bass swells. Entirely instrumental, music only: no singing, choir, speech, environmental sounds or combat effects. Clear acoustic instrument separation, comfortable middle registers, natural connected phrases and restrained dynamics.

style_description: 克制钢琴与单簧管；承认失落、温柔反思，保留重整与再出发的希望。
naming_basis: 提示词为tender reflection、readiness to regroup、never despair；“余潮”对应战后余绪，“再航”对应重新出发。
